All controls respond correctly, slider values commit on release, and PUT /api/me/profile returns 200.

Navigation to /!/dashboard/editor via sidebar Editor item

Slider card-blur: keyboard 20->25, drag commit->28 (smooth, value persists on release)
Card style chips cardstyle-classic / frosted / frosted-soft / outlined / aurora / transparent all clickable (individual testids per style)
card-bg-toggle, card-glow-toggle, name-glow-toggle all toggle true<->false
Save (data-testid=editor-save) triggers PUT https://.../api/me/profile -> 200 OK, changes persist to backend
No console errors thrown while interacting with sliders/chips/switches (only 2 pre-login 401s on /api/me which are expected auth probes)
notes: Parent container data-testid='cardstyle' is not present; chip selection is implemented as individual testids cardstyle-<style> (classic/frosted/frosted-soft/outlined/aurora/transparent). Not a bug, just a selector note for future tests.
The 2 console errors seen are 401s on /api/me fired before login completes, unrelated to the card editor fix.
